title: eludite.agents.start input
description: Start an ACP agent in the Agents window (View > Agents): spawn it, run ACP initialize and session/new with Eludite's MCP server, and report its state. It acts on the session the window shows (or `session`): with no session shown it starts a new one; restarting a live session keeps its transcript and record and starts a new ACP session in it; a stored session whose agent cannot resume it is replaced by a new session with the same agent. With no `agent`, the session's agent, else the window's selected agent (by default the first of the registry: the native Claude Code adapter when found, then the npx adapter, then the agents configured in settings); naming another agent than the session's stops that session and starts a new one with the named agent. Starting an agent that is already running does nothing unless `restart` is true.

agent.description: The name of an agent in the registry (see the output's `agents`), for example `Claude Code`.

restart.description: Stop the running agent of the session (if any) and start it again.

session.description: Act on this session (an `id` from eludite.agents.sessions) instead of the one the window shows; it becomes the one shown.
